connect.oauthLink: Connect **{provider}** from the dashboard — OAuth has to start from your signed-in dashboard session: {url}
connect.needsTarget: Give both `target` and `channel` to connect **{provider}** here, or run `/integration alerts add` afterwards to add watch targets.
connect.webhookGuidance: **{provider}** connects via a webhook. Use `/integration webhook create` to set up an inbound endpoint and get its URL/secret.
connect.unavailable: **{provider}** isn't fully configured on this server yet: missing {missingEnv}. The connection was still created and will start working once that's set.

disconnect.confirmBody: This stops alerts/polling for **{provider}** (`{label}`) and removes any stored OAuth token. You can reconnect any time.

list.title: Connections
list.empty: No integrations connected yet. Try `/integration connect` or `/integration alerts add`.
